quote: indicated in the control of grand mal, psychomotor, and focal epileptic seizures
note: Grand mal seizures are generalized/bilateral tonic-clonic seizures.

quote: treatment of asymptomatic T. vaginalis infection in females when the organism is associated with endocervicitis, cervicitis, or cervical erosion
note: Cervical erosion is the setting of the treated T. vaginalis infection.

quote: indicated for preoperative medication, support of anesthesia, for obstetrical analgesia
note: Obstetrical analgesia is management of labor pain.

quote: management of hypoglycemia due to hyperinsulinism associated with the following conditions
note: Drug treats hypoglycemia from hyperinsulinism caused by islet cell carcinoma, not the carcinoma itself.

quote: Complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis.
note: Explicitly indicated.

quote: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma ( 1.4 )
note: Explicitly indicated.

quote: Diphtheria: Infections due to Corynebacterium diphtheriae , as an adjunct to antitoxin
note: Adjunctive indication counts.

quote: maintenance treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
note: Label names COPD and asthma; bronchial disorder is an organ-system category.

quote: Treatment of postmenopausal osteoporosis in patients at risk of vitamin-D insufficiency.
note: Vitamin D insufficiency is the patient population; osteoporosis is treated.

quote: treatment of activated phosphoinositide 3-kinase delta syndrome (APDS)
note: Label names APDS only; inborn error of immunity is a whole disease class.

quote: improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus
note: Explicitly indicated.

quote: To control the manifestations of the manic type of manic-depressive illness.
note: Manic-depressive illness is bipolar disorder.
Indications are OA, RA, JRA, AS, acute pain, dysmenorrhea; bone pain not mentioned.

quote: Not recommended for use to improve glycemic control in patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus.
note: Explicit limitation of use for T1DM.

quote: Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura in adults
note: ITP (immune thrombocytopenia) is autoimmune thrombocytopenia.

quote: Pentazocine and Naloxone Tablets are indicated for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic
note: Combination product indication for severe pain counts.

quote: A major depressive episode (DSM-IV) implies a prominent and relatively persistent ... depressed or dysphoric mood
note: Label treats MDD; depressed mood is only a symptom in its definition.

quote: indicated for the treatment of hypertension
note: Hypertension explicitly indicated.

quote: Diabetic Macular Edema (DME) ( 1.2 ) Macular Edema Following Retinal Vein Occlusion (RVO)
note: Macular edema forms are indicated; edge is near parent.

quote: indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure
note: Malignant hypertension is a subtype of indicated hypertension.
Label treats systemic hypertension and edema; pulmonary hypertension is not mentioned or a subtype.

quote: Ibuprofen Tablets are indicated for relief of mild to moderate pain
note: Unqualified pain indication covers chronic widespread pain as a subtype.

quote: Uncomplicated urethritis in men due to Neisseria gonorrhoeae and for the treatment of other gonococcal infections.
note: Gonococcal infections indicated.

quote: Angina at rest including: Vasospastic (Prinzmetal's variant) angina Unstable (crescendo, pre-infarction) angina 2. Chronic stable angina
note: Angina explicitly indicated.

quote: Dermatographism
note: Familial dermatographia is a subtype of indicated dermatographism.

quote: Treatment of schizophrenia in adults
note: Explicitly indicated.

quote: Treatment of severely ill patients with schizophrenia who fail to respond adequately to standard antipsychotic treatment.
note: Treatment-resistant schizophrenia indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of community-acquired pneumonia
note: Explicitly indicated.

quote: congenital (erythroid) hypoplastic anemia (Diamond Blackfan anemia), pure red cell aplasia
note: Erythroid hypoplasia is named in hematologic indications.

quote: treatment of adults with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis (PsO)
note: Plaque psoriasis indicated; psoriasis is near parent.

quote: indicated as adjunctive therapy in the management of partial seizures
note: Partial seizures = focal-onset seizures.

quote: palliative treatment of advanced carcinoma of the breast or endometrium
note: Endometrial carcinoma explicitly indicated.

quote: radioactive diagnostic agent indicated for positron emission tomography (PET) of prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA) positive lesions in men with prostate cancer
note: Diagnostic imaging only, not treatment.

quote: Treatment of symptomatic gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
note: Explicitly indicated.
Back pain is not mentioned; only endometriosis-associated pain.

quote: treatment of narcolepsy with or without cataplexy
note: Narcolepsy without cataplexy explicitly covered.

quote: HR-positive advanced breast cancer in postmenopausal women
note: Breast cancer is a breast neoplasm; near-level granularity.
